From: Alexei Petrov <alexei@hepha.dev>

Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Trial top-up for HephDB CI (OSS maintainer)

Hi Neha,

I'm Alexei, one of the maintainers for HephDB (open-source distributed time-series DB). Our CI and community-run demo infra have been using Redwood's free tier credits through a PLG signup tied to alexei@hepha.dev. We started hitting quota limits this week — the CI builds that exercise model-based telemetry (small embedding/intent classification) are failing because the credits are exhausted.

HephDB is a small maintainer-run project but we have a lot of community contributors and CI runs that are important for PR velocity and security checks. Would Redwood be able to provide a small, one-time top-up (or a temporary trial extension) for the HephDB org account so we can keep CI and demos running while we work on optimizing token usage?

Details:
- GitHub org: https://github.com/hephdb/hephdb
- Account email: alexei@hepha.dev
- Typical monthly usage for the CI jobs: ~35k tokens (spikes during release testing)
- Request: additional 60k tokens or a 90-day trial extension (whichever fits existing program slots)

Happy to provide a short maintainer volunteer verification (github membership + handful of contributor commits) or point to our project governance doc. We can also accept a conditional credit package that expires after 90 days.

Thanks for considering — would love to keep the small demo site and CI pipelines healthy.

Best,
Alexei
Maintainer, HephDB Foundation
https://github.com/hephdb/hephdb

Hi Alexei — thanks for the note and for running HephDB. Really appreciate the detail.

We can often help with short-term credits for active OSS maintainers where CI/demos are impacted. To speed this along: can you confirm the GitHub org link (you included hephdb/hephdb, good) and the best email to tie the credit to (you listed alexei@hepha.dev)? Also, do you have a public list of maintainers we can use for verification?

I’m looping in Priyom (community programs) and Marissa (sales ops) to confirm the size of the top-up. Suggested internal ask: 60k tokens for 90 days, with a follow-up check at 60 days to see if you need optimization help or a smaller recurring grant. If you prefer a different amount let me know.

If that works I’ll open the credit request and we’ll send over the issuance details (self-serve link + expiration).

-Neha
